t: Introduction and overview — North Carolina-class Battleship
name: Introduction and overview — North Carolina-class Battleship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — North Carolina-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the North Carolina-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The North Carolina class — two ships — were America's first fast battleships: 44,800 tons at 28 knots with nine 16-inch/45 guns. North Carolina earned 15 battle stars in the Pacific; Washington sank the Japanese battleship Kirishima in 1942. North Carolina is a museum ship at Wilmington. Baseline facts: U.S. fast battleship; 2 built; nine 16-inch guns; 15 battle stars..
